about: Drive serves an HTML error page under the PDF's name and mime type, so pdf.js cannot parse it

connectorGaps: binary PDF: download_file_content returns the file as base64 content; n8n's loader parses the binary with pdf.js
reads.note: Google Drive v3 file download (n8n-nodes-base 2.47.7 download.operation): GET /drive/v3/files/<id>?fields=mimeType,name, then GET ?alt=media; the bytes become binary `data`

branches: no IF/Switch: download → summarisation chain (map-reduce over 3000-token chunks)
expect.offline: The PDFs are small stand-ins whose text pdf.js extracts (the binary Default Data Loader reads application/pdf through pdf.js); the summary is the stand-in model's. The file id is hard-coded in the Google Drive node's URL. The Token Splitter asks https://tiktoken.pages.dev/js/gpt2.json for its encoding (seven tries, read-default 404 on the bench, PROPOSALS P26) and LangChain falls back to its approximate count, on n8n's side as checked in a canned run
